list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT account, display_name FROM n360.account ORDER BY display_name
list.definition: SELECT account, display_name FROM n360.account ORDER BY display_name

list.name: line
list.label: Contract line
list.query:
SELECT l.line_key, concat(concat(l.channel, if(l.sheet_customer != l.account, concat(' (', l.sheet_customer, ')'), '')), ' · from ',
        toString(toDayOfMonth(l.start_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(l.start_date, '%b %Y'))
        FROM n360.contract_line AS l WHERE l.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY l.channel, l.start_date
list.definition:
SELECT l.line_key, concat(concat(l.channel, if(l.sheet_customer != l.account, concat(' (', l.sheet_customer, ')'), '')), ' · from ',
        toString(toDayOfMonth(l.start_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(l.start_date, '%b %Y'))
        FROM n360.contract_line AS l WHERE l.account IN (${account:singlequote}) ORDER BY l.channel, l.start_date

panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Where this line stands: its status (n360.v_contract_status, proposed thresholds), and where the stored forecast's rate takes it by the term end.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(c.n > 0, c.s, concat(l.channel, ' is in a pooled entitlement: its use counts toward the pool, which is compared with billed (customer page).')) AS sentence
        FROM (SELECT count() AS n, any(concat(full_label, ': ', multiIf(
                  status = 'over billed', concat('over billed, ', toString(round(pct_billed)), '% of billed'),
                  status = 'will exceed', concat('set to exceed billed on ', concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(cross_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(cross_date, '%b %Y')), ', ',
                                                 toString(dateDiff('day', cross_date, end_date)), ' days before the term ends'),
                  pct_billed IS NULL, lower(transform(if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status), ['over billed', 'will exceed', 'renewal risk', 'below pace', 'ahead', 'on pace', 'too early', 'under review', 'billed not recorded', 'unmapped', 'not built', 'not measured', 'not read'], ['Over billed', 'Will exceed', 'Renewal risk', 'Below pace', 'Ahead', 'On pace', 'Too early to tell', 'Under review', 'Billed not recorded', 'Unmapped', 'Not built', 'Not measured', 'Not reported yet'], '')),
                  concat(lower(transform(if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status), ['over billed', 'will exceed', 'renewal risk', 'below pace', 'ahead', 'on pace', 'too early', 'under review', 'billed not recorded', 'unmapped', 'not built', 'not measured', 'not read'], ['Over billed', 'Will exceed', 'Renewal risk', 'Below pace', 'Ahead', 'On pace', 'Too early to tell', 'Under review', 'Billed not recorded', 'Unmapped', 'Not built', 'Not measured', 'Not reported yet'], '')), ': ', toString(round(pct_billed)), '% used, ', toString(round(pct_term)),
                         '% of the term gone')),
                  if(forecast_end_pct IS NULL, '', concat(' · ', toString(round(forecast_end_pct)), '% by the term end at the current rate')))) AS s
              FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote})) AS c
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT channel FROM n360.contract_line WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote})) AS l

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Used
panels.description:
The line's contract measure from its start date, and the last 30 days.

**Source:** n360.contract_line  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reported_measured AS Used, reported_last30_measured AS `Last 30 days`
        FROM n360.contract_line WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote})

panels.title: Billed
panels.description:
The billed amount for this line (after any signed SOW override; the basis is under "How this line is measured"). A pooled line has none of its own.

**Source:** n360.contract_line  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** the contract term

targets.rawSql: SELECT billed AS Billed FROM n360.contract_line WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote})

panels.title: % of billed
panels.description:
Used / billed in the line's own measure, and its contract status (n360.v_contract_status, proposed thresholds). A pooled line has no % of its own: see the pool on the Customer dashboard.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql: SELECT pct_billed AS `% of billed`, if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) AS Status FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote})

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: a pooled line (measured at the pool)

panels.title: % of term
panels.description:
Days elapsed / term days.

**Source:** n360.v_line_status  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.pct_term_elapsed AS `% of term`,
               toUInt32(round(s.pct_term_elapsed * l.term_days / 100)) AS `Days in`, l.term_days AS `Term days`
        FROM n360.v_line_status AS s INNER JOIN n360.contract_line AS l ON l.line_key = s.line_key WHERE s.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})

panels.title: Forecast to horizon
panels.description:
The stored forecast: used + rate x days to the horizon (the earlier of contract end and the month end 3 months out), as % of billed; rate = last 30 days / 30. Never recomputed here.

**Source:** n360.forecast via n360.v_line_pace  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** to the horizon

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * forecast_m3 / billed, 1) AS `% of billed`, round(rate_per_day) AS `Per day`,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(horizon)), ' ', formatDateTime(horizon, '%b %Y')) AS Horizon
        FROM n360.v_line_pace WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND forecast_m3 IS NOT NULL

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no forecast (pooled, not implemented or not measurable)

panels.title: How this line is measured
panels.description:
How the contract measure for this line is counted, from conversations to the measure, and whether this view's % of billed matches the existing page's figure.

**Source:** n360.contract_line, n360.rule, n360.source, n360.v_line_status  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** the contract term

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Item, Value FROM (
            SELECT 1 AS o, 'Measure' AS Item, toString(l.measure) AS Value FROM n360.contract_line AS l WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Contract rule', if(l.rule_id IS NULL, 'None: engaged conversations (billable unit unconfirmed)', r.label)
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l LEFT JOIN n360.rule AS r ON r.rule_id = l.rule_id WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'What counts', if(l.rule_id IS NULL, 'Conversations the platform flags as engaged', r.counts_plain)
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l LEFT JOIN n360.rule AS r ON r.rule_id = l.rule_id WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Rule status', if(l.rule_id IS NULL, 'no rule', toString(r.status))
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l LEFT JOIN n360.rule AS r ON r.rule_id = l.rule_id WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'Conversations → engaged → measured',
                if(l.reported_measured IS NULL, NULL, concat(if(l.reported_consumed_convs IS NULL, NULL, if(l.reported_consumed_convs >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_consumed_convs, 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(l.reported_consumed_convs, 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_consumed_convs % 1000), 3, '0')), if(l.reported_consumed_convs >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_consumed_convs, 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_consumed_convs % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(l.reported_consumed_convs)))), ' → ',
                   if(l.reported_engaged_flag IS NULL, NULL, if(l.reported_engaged_flag >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_engaged_flag, 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(l.reported_engaged_flag, 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_engaged_flag % 1000), 3, '0')), if(l.reported_engaged_flag >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_engaged_flag, 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_engaged_flag % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(l.reported_engaged_flag)))), ' → ', if(l.reported_measured IS NULL, NULL, if(l.reported_measured >= 1000000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_measured, 1000000)), ',', leftPad(toString(intDiv(l.reported_measured, 1000) % 1000), 3, '0'), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_measured % 1000), 3, '0')), if(l.reported_measured >= 1000, concat(toString(intDiv(l.reported_measured, 1000)), ',', leftPad(toString(l.reported_measured % 1000), 3, '0')), toString(l.reported_measured))))))
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Matches the page', if(l.reported_pct_page IS NULL OR s.pct_billed IS NULL, NULL,
                concat(if(abs(l.reported_pct_page - s.pct_billed) < 0.05, 'Yes', 'NO'), ': page ',
                       toString(round(l.reported_pct_page, 1)), '%, here ', toString(round(s.pct_billed, 1)), '%'))
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l INNER JOIN n360.v_line_status AS s ON s.line_key = l.line_key WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'Billed basis', multiIf(l.pool_id IS NOT NULL, 'billed at the pool', l.billed IS NULL,
                'blank on the sheet', l.unit != '', concat('signed SOW: ', l.unit), 'entitlement sheet')
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
            UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Source', ifNull(any(src.description), '')
                FROM n360.contract_line AS l LEFT JOIN n360.source AS src
                  ON src.source_id = if(l.rule_id IS NULL, 'consumption_days', 'consumption_rules') WHERE l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
        ) ORDER BY o

panels.title: Cumulative used against billed
panels.description:
Used so far (solid), the stored forecast from the data-through day to its horizon (dashed), and the billed amount (dashed red) over the term. Days not read add nothing to the running total. Not measurable and not implemented lines have no usage line.

**Source:** n360.line_day, n360.v_line_pace (n360.forecast), n360.contract_line  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** start date to the end of the term

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, Used, Forecast, Billed FROM (
            SELECT toDateTime(d.day) AS time,
                   toNullable(toFloat64(sum(d.measured) OVER (ORDER BY d.day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING))) AS Used,
                   CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)') AS Forecast, CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)') AS Billed
            FROM n360.line_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.contract_line AS l ON l.series_key = d.series_key
            WHERE d.kind = 'line' AND l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND l.measure NOT IN ('not measurable', 'not implemented') AND d.day >= l.start_date
            UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(data_through), NULL, toFloat64(used), NULL FROM n360.v_line_pace WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND forecast_m3 IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(horizon), NULL, toFloat64(forecast_m3), NULL FROM n360.v_line_pace WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND forecast_m3 IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(start_date), NULL, NULL, toFloat64(billed) FROM n360.contract_line WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND billed IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(end_date), NULL, NULL, toFloat64(billed) FROM n360.contract_line WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND billed IS NOT NULL
        ) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Measure against the engaged flag, by month
panels.description:
Per month: the contract measure beside the platform engaged flag, so a contract rule's effect is visible (for lines with no rule they are the same). Never one replaced by the other.

**Source:** n360.line_day  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day, by calendar month

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(d.day), '%b %y') AS Month, sum(d.measured) AS `Contract measure`,
               sum(d.engaged) AS `Engaged (platform flag)`
        FROM n360.line_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.contract_line AS l ON l.series_key = d.series_key
        WHERE d.kind = 'line' AND l.line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND d.day >= l.start_date
        GROUP BY toStartOfMonth(d.day) ORDER BY toStartOfMonth(d.day)

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: a line with no daily series (not implemented)

panels.title: VAs on this line
panels.description:
The VAs feeding this line and each one's share of the line's conversations (conversations, not the contract measure). Click a VA to open it.

**Source:** n360.line_va, n360.va_day  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** the 30 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, lv.region AS Region, sum(d.conversations) AS `Conversations, 30 days`,
               round(100 * sum(d.conversations) / sum(sum(d.conversations)) OVER (), 1) AS `Share`,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', lv.account, '&var-va=', toString(lv.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.line_va AS lv INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = lv.bot_id
        LEFT JOIN n360.va_day AS d ON d.bot_id = lv.bot_id AND d.day > (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') - 30
        WHERE lv.line_key IN (${line:singlequote})
        GROUP BY lv.bot_id, lv.account, lv.region, v.va_name, v.channels ORDER BY `Conversations, 30 days` DESC

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: a line with no VA (not implemented)

panels.title: % of billed, night by night
panels.description:
What N360 said each night for this line, so a jump between nights is visible. Shown once 7 nights are stored.

**Source:** n360.line_totals_history (append-only, one row per line per night)  
**Filter:** Contract line  
**Window:** every stored night

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(data_date) AS time, pct_billed_page AS `% of billed`
        FROM n360.line_totals_history
        WHERE line_key IN (${line:singlequote}) AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT data_date) FROM n360.line_totals_history) >= 7
        ORDER BY time
